title: PostgreSQL feature map
caption: SQL goes through parser, planner and executor, while COPY and NOTIFY take a separate utility path, and everything ends up in tables, catalogs and the WAL that logical decoding reads.

title: Life of one INSERT
caption: Follow the numbers to see one INSERT get parsed, planned, checked, stored, trigger-checked and committed.

badges.meaning: Parser turns SQL into a tree
heap_insert stores the row and logs it to WAL
AFTER trigger runs the foreign key check (ri_triggers.c)

title: Features in the source tree
caption: Each feature has a home folder: types in utils/adt, languages in src/pl, and optional extras in contrib.
